item.title: Blaze destroys Habitat for Humanity truck
item.description: A late-night fire destroyed a truck at the Restore, a thrift shop in downtown Watsonville run by Habitat for Humanity Monterey Bay. item.title: Housing voucher program at risk unless Congress acts
item.description: Hundreds of Santa Cruz County families could lose their federal rental assistance as early as December unless Congress restores funding to a pandemic-era housing voucher program, local officials warned Tuesday.
